crossRefs.note: They gathered together to Mizpah, and drew water, and poured it out before Yahweh, and fasted on that day, and said…
Samuel said to all Israel, “Behold, I have listened to your voice in all that you said to me, and have made a king over…
Samuel died; and all Israel gathered themselves together, and mourned for him, and buried him at his house at Ramah.…
Yahweh raised up judges, who saved them out of the hand of those who plundered them.
Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king…
The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.
Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty…
